facts.statement: In December 2009, Free Realms had holiday events underway or about to begin, offering themed events, special quests and seasonal treats.
facts.quote: This December, EverQuest®, EverQuest® II and Free Realms players will enjoy celebrations filled with themed events, special quests and seasonal treats.

article_summaries.title: Experience a Virtual Winter Wonderland With Sony Online Entertainment
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer news roundup of Sony Online Entertainment's December 2009 holiday events. Free Realms is one of seven SOE games named, and the article gives only general detail: holiday events were underway, with themed events, special quests and seasonal treats. It names no specific quests, items or rewards for Free Realms.
